summary: This bill amends federal contracting law to bar agencies from including minimum education requirements for contractor personnel in solicitations unless the contracting officer provides a written justification explaining why the requirement is necessary, while directing OMB to issue implementation guidance that encourages alternatives and requiring a GAO compliance report.
